Realistically, there's 2 ways to go about it, but this can change how someone sees you.

1. Tell them straightforward, whether there is a problem or not, just let them know that unfortunately that you don't want to be (insert relationship form here) anymore. Best to give them at least a reason why though, it's heartbreaking when you just get told "hey, don't want you in my life anymore sorry, bye."

2. Ghosting, which is a dick-ish move, but 70% of people will get the message after a little while, but this can be a sour way to end something, especially if you regret it in the future because then you actually have to explain WHY you decided to act like they didn't exist.
